row.notes: Per-draw pipeline-state resolve in the Gfx2 context: looks up the PSO in the shader group's hash map (key = RT-set key at ctx+0x12e0), builds the PSO desc from a 0x290-byte copy when missing, and on failure logs (channel GFX2/RENDER_MISC) "DX12: PSO doesn't exist -> shadergroup:%s hash=0x016%I64x" plus per-RTV/DSV format lines 'DX12:     RTV%i   FORMAT:%s' / 'DX12:     DSV%i   FORMAT:%s'; fatal via Ne_FatalAbort. Sole named caller Render_Gfx_SubmitMeshDraw. Addon: where missing-PSO crashes are reported.

verify.notes: V8511 PSO lookup, 0x290 copy, logs DX12: PSO does not exist -> shadergroup on GFX2 / RENDER_MISC
